product.name: Science Shows
product.description: Theatrical presentations demonstrating scientific experiments and principles to engage audiences with basic educational concepts.

product.name: STEM Camps
product.description: Seasonal camps offering hands-on learning in STEM, robotics, and programming for students to apply knowledge in practical settings.

product.name: Awareness Campaigns
product.description: Events designed to educate the public about the importance and impact of science in everyday life.

product.name: Science Bus
product.description: A mobile science laboratory that delivers hands-on science education to students, especially in underserved areas.

product.name: STEM Carnivals
product.description: Events featuring a variety of STEM activities, games, and exhibits designed to educate and engage people of all ages.

product.name: STEM Programs
product.description: Educational initiatives focused on teaching and applying science, technology, engineering, and mathematics concepts through curricula and kits.
